learning_objective: The learner can explain the goal of preference finetuning and why capturing universal human preference mathematically is challenging.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that a single, universal human preference can be mathematically defined and embedded into AI.
Assuming preference-based feedback is always appropriate, even for questions that require factual correctness.
Thinking that more preference finetuning always improves a model without risking over-censorship or boring outputs.
